A word near the edge of a recording window should appear once in the final text. It should not disappear, and it should not be repeated because two windows overlap.

I will read a few anonymous pairs of outputs and choose the one that keeps my words and layout most faithfully. If the outputs are equally good, I will mark them as a tie.
